integrity: Proof depends on published four-step random-walk density and elementary midpoint-density Jacobians; numerical checks are corroborative, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Conditional asymptotic for independent endpoint-uniform circular chords only; four-step radial density and its marginal coefficients are known prior results; historical priority of the marked limit provisional.
title: A two-channel log-uniform geometry for coincident random chord midpoints
